g.text: Every window rect at 1:1 as a static 1 px spectrum outline (sampled
by x), 8% navy fill, app glyph centred at 30%. No titles, no wallpaper.
96 px ExtraLight tabular, the date eyebrow and a
320 x 44 auth field sit in the largest empty region
the placement map has. Nothing centred by default.
Enter: the field edge goes blue, then
the outlines fill 8% to 100% with the
real windows. Nothing slides or scales.
the outlines, cyan at birth, rose at death.

svg.text: Phosphor · lockscreen · the layout you left, as an outline
